propositions: rebar hardcodes comment ceiling to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) despite Jira DC's admin-configurable jira.text.field.character.limit property allowing 0 (unlimited) to 2147483647
when a DC administrator raises jira.text.field.character.limit above 32767, rebar silently truncates comments that Jira would accept, causing permanent divergence between local and remote bodies
comment sanitization incorrectly depends on the description fitter (fit_outbound), creating a trap where future changes to description fitting could retarget comment limits
rebar's non-admin PAT cannot read /rest/api/2/application-properties/advanced-settings to auto-discover the instance's ceiling, making configuration the only viable remedy
the constant WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT misattributes its origin to Cloud comment limits rather than jira.text.field.character.limit, reversing actual causality
